title: Сгенерировать и проверить SPDX SBOM, SLSA provenance и conditional GitHub attestation
summary: Связать каждый exact P9.3 subject с валидным SPDX 2.3 SBOM и SLSA v1.2 provenance, а GitHub attestation выпускать только при доказанной hosted capability.
why: Lockfile inventory, archive contents, provenance statement и signed platform attestation отвечают на разные вопросы; смешивание их даёт ложную supply-chain гарантию. `RAG:✅` в `@plan/knowledge/research-P9-design-rag.json`.

include: Normative SPDX 2.3 JSON per subject; separate source/lock and extracted-artifact catalogs; pinned Syft generation plus independent schema/tool validation; exact subject/package/checksum reconciliation; optional CycloneDX derivative only при named consumer; SLSA v1.2 provenance predicate with build definition/run materials; offline verification; conditional full-SHA-pinned `actions/attest` path and explicit capability status.
exclude: Vulnerability-free claim from SBOM; runtime correctness; keyless attestation outside trusted hosted identity; pretending an unsigned local statement is a GitHub attestation; mandatory CycloneDX duplication; public transparency/publication; long-lived signing keys.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: SPDX 2.3 JSON is the sole normative SBOM format for P9; CycloneDX is emitted only as a declared non-normative derivative when a concrete consumer is recorded. Scan lock/source inputs and extracted exact subjects separately and retain both results. Every release subject has a unique SBOM namespace, SHA-256 subject binding and validated package/file relationships; tool output alone is insufficient without schema and reconciliation checks. Provenance subject digest equals the P9.3 archive digest and materials include source/tree, contract, content-manifest and tool-lock digests. Use the current unified `actions/attest` action at a reviewed full commit SHA, with `id-token: write`/`attestations: write` only in the attestation job. Private/internal GitHub attestation is `unavailable-plan` unless Enterprise Cloud capability is positively proved; local provenance remains `statement-verified`, never `attested`.
guidance: Make generation and verification separate commands and corrupt each relationship in tests. Preserve raw Syft/SPDX validator versions and outputs by digest. Do not scan the enclosing workflow artifact and call that the package SBOM. Keep platform bundle/download identifiers separate from release-file digests. Design the evidence receipt so `verified`, `unavailable-plan`, `available-disabled` and `not-executed` cannot collapse into pass.
deliverables: Validated normative SPDX SBOMs, exact SLSA provenance statements, conditional GitHub attestation contract/path and supply-chain evidence receipt for P9.5/P10.
